reviews.text: The receptionist was very nice. Just liked her soon as I walked in. The vet was as nice too. The surgery was far from my house but I rather go there then local, and I will now always go there.
Very reasonable prices to kerp my furry baby safe and healthy.  Excellent vet who is kind and gentle and listened to my concerns
Excellent service as usual. Really lovely vets with friendly staff. Nice intimate feel about it as it’s a small vets but very capable.

In all our years of using 608 vets we have never been let down. They are friendly, polite, knowledgeable and experienced,  we have been with them for over 40 years and the health of our pets has been the better for this.

My 8 month old Kitten got spayed here and I am very happy with the overall experience. Friendly Vet, Nurses and staff. My Kitten had a smooth recovery and everything went well. Highly recommend. Thank you 😊 …

They knew my cat had the same problem as before, but instead of prescribing the same medication, they gave her a different one.

They told me that if she didn’t get better, I should call them back. When I did, I was surprised that they wanted to charge another consultation fee.

I asked why, since I had already explained that she was experiencing the same problem. It felt like the vet had simply made an assumption without fully considering her medical history.

Having been to a few vets with my older cat and having bad experiences it’s an absolute breath of fresh air using 608 vets acocks green! What a lovely, friendly, kind and just genuinely amazing bunch of staff! Thank you for going above and beyond for penny!!

Mate the vet that saw our Syrian hamster Peanut was exceptional in his care and support . We have struggled to find an exotic vet to look at Peanut and although it wasn't the best news , Peanut was given the best care and us ongoing support in his palliative care .
We couldn't have asked for more
The reception team from Solihull were also great in accommodating us with an appointment and communication, friendly and understanding
Thankyou ☺️
